actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: RealFr3 subclasses BaseEnv and is described as a dummy environment for showcasing robots in an empty scene
RealFr3 supports the reward modes none, dense and sparse, in that order
The RealFr3 constructor's default robot_uids is panda and it passes robot_uids to BaseEnv
Fr3Umi is registered as the agent uid fr3_umi
Fr3Umi names seven FR3 arm joints and two FR3 finger joints
The Fr3Umi arm pd_joint_delta_pos controller bounds every arm joint delta to -0.1 to 0.1 and applies it as a delta
The Fr3Umi gripper position controller bounds the gripper command to -0.01 to 0.04
The Fr3Umi controller map binds pd_joint_delta_pos to the arm delta controller and the gripper position controller
fr3_umi_task_init_qpos is a nine-value FR3 UMI start configuration
RealFr3._load_scene builds a ground and sets collision group bit 30
RealFr3.evaluate returns an empty dict and _get_obs_extra returns an empty dict, so the task adds no reward term and no extra observation
RealFr3 configures wrist_cam and right_cam at 640x480 with near 0.01 and far 100
RealFr3 configures a 640x480 render camera with near 0.01 and far 100
The GSWorld wrapper configures sim_freq=100 and control_freq=20 for its moving-robot environment
The Franka motion-planning example defaults to sim_freq 100 and control_freq 20

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial joint noise and its dynamics are deterministic, so this package repeats a trajectory for one seed; upstream draws from torch/numpy generators, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators or constraints: the fake integrates the arm joint deltas directly and sets the gripper target kinematically (F0)

the real action space is assembled by the external ManiSkill package from the Fr3Umi controller configurations; the clone states the physical delta bounds (-0.1 to 0.1 for the arm and -0.01 to 0.04 for the gripper) but not the normalisation or the exact action dimension, so the fake's Box(-1, 1) with eight values is a placeholder, not a verified upstream action space

the real state observation is the agent qpos and qvel plus any controller state assembled by the external ManiSkill BaseAgent; the fake returns the 18-value qpos/qvel part only, so a controller state field is not covered
the two 640x480 wrist and right cameras and the render camera are not modelled: the gymnasium bridge serves the scalar world state only, and the fake returns no rgb, depth or segmentation array
the fake starts from fr3_umi_task_init_qpos plus placeholder noise; the real agent's reset state and keyframe selection are performed by the external ManiSkill BaseAgent and are not reproduced
reset options are accepted and ignored by the fake; the upstream environment consumes them (for example reconfigure), which is not modelled
the fake draws its reset noise with Python's random.Random while upstream uses torch/numpy generators, so one seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance simulated time by the configured 50 ms control step only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last world state stays readable
